# DocumentSettingsExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Extension methods for configuring PDF version, PDF/A, and bookmarks.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AddBookmark`](#addbookmark): Adds a bookmark (outline item) to the document.
- [`AddBookmarks`](#addbookmarks): Adds multiple bookmarks to the document.
- [`AsPdf17`](#aspdf17): Sets the PDF version to 1.7 and enables all PDF 1.7 features.
- [`AsPdf20`](#aspdf20): Sets the PDF version to 2.0.
- [`AsPdfA`](#aspdfa): Selects PDF/A-2b archival mode.
- [`AsPdfA4`](#aspdfa4): Enables PDF/A-4 baseline archival mode.
- [`WithWatermark`](#withwatermark): Adds a text watermark with default settings (gray, 15% opacity, -45 degree rotation, 72pt).

### `AddBookmark`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AddBookmark(DocumentSettings settings, string title, int pageIndex)
```

*static*

Adds a bookmark (outline item) to the document. Automatically sets version to PDF 1.7.

- `settings`: The document settings
- `title`: Display title of the bookmark
- `pageIndex`: 0-based page index this bookmark navigates to

### `AddBookmarks`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AddBookmarks(DocumentSettings settings, IEnumerable<BookmarkItem> bookmarks)
```

*static*

Adds multiple bookmarks to the document. Automatically sets version to PDF 1.7.

### `AsPdf17`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AsPdf17(DocumentSettings settings)
```

*static*

Sets the PDF version to 1.7 and enables all PDF 1.7 features.

### `AsPdf20`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AsPdf20(DocumentSettings settings)
```

*static*

Sets the PDF version to 2.0. This is the foundation for PDF/A-4 and PDF/UA-2, but does not enable either conformance claim by itself.

### `AsPdfA`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AsPdfA(DocumentSettings settings)
```

*static*

Selects PDF/A-2b archival mode. Automatically sets version to PDF 1.7. Cannot be used with encryption.

### `AsPdfA4`

```csharp
DocumentSettings AsPdfA4(DocumentSettings settings)
```

*static*

Enables PDF/A-4 baseline archival mode. Automatically sets version to PDF 2.0. For attachments use `PdfA4f`; for accessibility add `PdfUa2`. Cannot be used with encryption.

### `WithWatermark`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithWatermark(DocumentSettings settings, string text)
DocumentSettings WithWatermark(DocumentSettings settings, string text, float opacity, float rotationDegrees)
```

*static*

Adds a text watermark with default settings (gray, 15% opacity, -45 degree rotation, 72pt).
